title: The Returning Employee
briefing: Routine re-verification. Ms Thompson is returning from four weeks of leave and her answers on form RV-2 do not match her linguistic baseline. The automatic check flagged her at 71% deviation. Compare her archived messages with her new answers, examine the supporting files, and decide whether the person who filled in this form is Maria Thompson.

lines.text: Reason: immediate family medical (father, cardiac surgery). Approved: E. Ross.
Forms received: found in HR in-tray, 19 Sep, 17:40. Not handed over in person.
Employee reports severe insomnia. Prescribed zolpidem 10 mg from 12 Oct. Known side effects: memory gaps, confusion about recent events, flattened affect.
Fit to return: yes, with monitoring. 'She is exhausted, not absent.'
Session timed out 3 times. Fields 1, 2 and 4 were completed using the HR phrase-assist template. Fields 5 and 6 were typed directly.

evidence.title: Register shift: informal to formal
evidence.description: Archived messages are lowercase, abbreviated and warm. The new answer is formal and impersonal. A change this large is consistent with substitution, but also with templates, stress, or someone trying hard to sound employable.
evidence.explanation: The most visible anomaly, and the reason she was flagged. On its own it proves nothing: the submission log shows this field was written with the HR template.

evidence.title: Childhood memory has drifted
evidence.description: On file: age 8, Tucson, a broken arm. New answer: age nine, Phoenix, a broken wrist. The shape of the memory is intact; three details have moved.
evidence.explanation: Real memories drift in exactly this way. An imitation working from the archive would have copied the details correctly.

evidence.title: A conversation that did not happen
evidence.description: She says she handed her forms to Elena Ross in person. Her own message, and the HR receipt, say the forms were left in an in-tray after Ross had gone home.
evidence.explanation: A false memory of a recent event. Alarming, until you read the occupational health note about her medication.

evidence.title: Flattened emotional response
evidence.description: A month ago she wrote about crying in a parking garage. Today she feels 'adequate'. The emotional range has collapsed.
evidence.explanation: Flat affect is a listed side effect of her prescription, and this field was also template-assisted.

evidence.title: Medication explains the gaps
evidence.description: A dated prescription for a sleep medication whose side effects are memory gaps, confusion about recent events and flattened affect. This accounts for every memory and emotional anomaly in the form.
evidence.explanation: The single most important document in the file. It turns three alarming findings into one tired woman.

evidence.title: Her own voice resurfaces
evidence.description: Where she typed directly, the lowercase, the apology and the printer joke all return. The baseline voice is still there underneath the form.
evidence.explanation: The fields she typed herself sound exactly like Maria: lowercase, apologetic, still at war with the printer.

evidence.title: Template-assisted fields
evidence.description: The submission log shows the formal answers were produced with the HR phrase-assist template after repeated timeouts. The formality belongs to the software, not to her.
evidence.explanation: Explains the register shift completely. The system flagged its own template.

result_explanation: The inconsistencies are explained by exhaustion and personal stress. Maria Thompson has not slept properly in a month, is taking medication that affects memory and mood, and completed half the form with a corporate template because the page kept timing out. Every anomaly points at a tired person, not at an imitation. Remember this case: strange is not the same as false.

VERIFIED_HUMAN.summary: Maria Thompson's access is restored. She returns to workstation 3-114 on Tuesday.

SUSPICIOUS.summary: Maria Thompson returns under monitored access. Her messages will be read by a second analyst for ninety days. She has been told why.

UNDETERMINED.summary: No conclusion recorded. Maria Thompson returns under monitored access by default. Management notes that an analyst who cannot decide is of limited use.

CORRUPTED_AI.summary: Maria Thompson's access has been revoked on your recommendation. An extraction interview has been scheduled. Occupational Health has filed an objection.
